Class EasyBot

java.lang.Object
splendor.entity.player.Player
splendor.entity.bot.Bot
splendor.entity.bot.EasyBot
public class EasyBot extends Bot
A simple bot that uses basic heuristics: buy cheap preferred-color cards, collect gems toward visible targets, and reserve when nothing else is useful.
